domainName: Premium Body Care and Home Fragrance
methodology: Empowered-style OKRs with a small set of company objectives, linked source objectives, explicit ownership, and measurable key results.
description: KTLO objectives for reliability, compliance, privacy, and operational integrity.
okrDesignPrinciples: Objectives describe customer and business outcomes, not feature delivery.
Key results measure meaningful movement on customer or business KPIs.
Every key result names executing and supporting teams so accountability is explicit.

companyObjectives.title: 2026-Q2 Maintain commercial, privacy, and claim integrity
companyObjectives.statement: Keep checkout, inventory, consent, identity, product data, and claim workflows reliable enough that premium promises remain trustworthy.

objectives.title: 2026-Q2 Commercial and claim integrity KTLO goal
objectives.objective: Reduce operational risk across checkout, inventory, privacy, identity, and claim-publication workflows.

keyResults.target: Keep median recovery below 45 minutes for priority commerce and store incidents
keyResults.statement: Keep customer-facing commerce and store issues within recovery tolerance.

executingTeams.intent: Maintain checkout, payment, tax, promotion, and risk reliability.

supportingTeams.intent: Maintain availability, order, and fulfillment recovery.
Maintain identity, consent, and telemetry integrity.

keyResults.target: Keep below 0.5% of published SKUs with corrected claim or ingredient defects
keyResults.statement: Prevent unapproved or inaccurate claims from reaching customer-facing channels.

executingTeams.intent: Maintain product data, claim approvals, and launch gates.

supportingTeams.intent: Maintain audit logs and data quality monitoring.
